SAP Functional FICO Analyst

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Job Purposes

The SAP Functional FICO Analyst is an individual contributor providing functional support, configuration, and minor-change delivery for SAP Finance (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules across CASS-served entities in Indonesia. The role partners closely with Finance business process owners (R2R), supports period-end activities, and coordinates with ABAP, BASIS, and 3P AMS partners.

Key responsibilities include:

Functional Support & Configuration:
• Resolve incidents and service requests on FI sub-modules (GL, AP, AR, AA, Banking) and CO sub-modules (CCA, PCA, Internal Orders, Product Costing, COPA).
• Perform configuration, unit testing, and integration testing for minor changes and enhancements.
• Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities.

Change & Project Delivery:
• Gather requirements, perform impact assessment, prepare functional specifications, and coordinate with ABAP for development.
• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles with Finance key users; prepare end-user documentation and training.
• Manage transports and follow transport governance to QA/PRD.

Integration & S/4HANA Readiness:
• Ensure FICO integration with MM, SD, PM, and PP modules is consistent.
• Contribute to SAP S/4HANA readiness assessments, simplification items, and migration planning.

Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination:
• Coordinate / oversee Kyndryl, T-Systems, and other 3P AMS partners on assigned tickets and changes.
• Engage Finance, Tax, and Treasury process owners on priorities and roadmaps.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or related field.
• Minimum 2 years of hands-on SAP FICO functional experience, with at least one full implementation or rollout cycle.
• Strong configuration knowledge across FI (GL, AP, AR, AA, Banking) and CO (CCA, PCA, Internal Orders, Product Costing, COPA).
• Working knowledge of FICO integration with MM, SD, PM/PP and the OTC/PTP/RTR end-to-end flows.
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance (Universal Journal, New Asset Accounting) is strongly preferred.
• Familiar with SAP Solution Manager / ChaRM transport governance and ITIL incident/change processes.
• Petrochemical, manufacturing, or process-industry experience is an advantage.
• Relevant SAP certifications (S/4HANA Finance, SAP Activate) are a plus.
• Strong communication in Bahasa Indonesia; working-level English sufficient for documentation, ticket handling, and coordination with regional/3P teams.

About Us

INDICO is Telkomsel Group’s digital company, focused on developing and scaling digital platforms beyond core connectivity.

As part of Telkomsel Group, INDICO enables collaboration to support end-to-end digital use cases, ranging from customer engagement and transactions to loyalty, commerce, and data intelligence.

Through its platforms, INDICO transforms group capabilities into scalable and repeatable solutions that support Telkomsel’s digital growth and unlock new business opportunities across the ecosystem.

INDICO believe we can reach beyond to empower Indonesians and enable businesses through our strong core values of EPIC WAY (Excellence, Positivity, Impactful Collaboration, Customer First, Walk the Talk, Accountability, Yes-if Mindset).

Job Description

• Manage stock availability and ensure sufficient inventory to support business and sales activities.
• Calculate stock requirements and working capital needs.
• Monitor inventory levels and identify potential shortages or excess stock.
• Monitor and analyze sales transaction performance.
• Coordinate with Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure stock availability aligns with business demand.
• Prepare and maintain stock and sales-related reports.

Requirements

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.

• Good coordination and communication skills.
